issue_title: [Security] os.fchmod is Unix-only, will raise AttributeError on Windows

source_files.description: Added try/except around os.fchmod to handle AttributeError on Windows

commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_issue_6840_windows_compat.py

implementation_details.approach: Wrap os.fchmod in try/except AttributeError and fall back to os.chmod on Windows
implementation_details.root_cause: os.fchmod is Unix-only and raises AttributeError on Windows
implementation_details.fix_strategy: Graceful degradation - use os.chmod as cross-platform fallback

risks_and_limitations: On Windows, chmod may have limited effect due to different permission model
The fallback uses path-based chmod instead of fd-based fchmod
